content.comment_body: Hello, How can I save the value of a counter so it remains after restarting the [product_name]? I set the value in B001 and want this value to be retained after powering the [product_name] on and off. Is this possible?
In the counter properties, there is a retentivity option. When enabled, the counter value will be retained even after the [product_name] is powered off.
Hello [user_name], If you did not understand what [user_name] means, here is your corrected file. Best regards

I have encountered the same issue. The retentivity option retains the output state of the block, but I need the actual counter value to be saved. When the controller turns off and then back on, the counter should resume from that value and continue running the program. How can this be achieved? Regards!

Hi, Wishing you a healthy and successful new year. Please refer to the German resource for information on saving (analog) values. Additional details are available in the Flow Totalization section. Best regards [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users are seeking a way to keep counter values persistent in [product_name] devices after a power cycle. The guidance about the retentivity option leads to some confusion, as it only stores the output state and not necessarily the actual counter value, indicating a gap in understanding persistent data features. There is a clear need for an intuitive solution that reliably retains counter values during power cycles.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want the counter value to survive power cycles and automatically resume operation from the last saved value, without requiring manual steps or risking data loss.
